|translation='''Title:''' Tauntaun Handler.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a creature vehicle he rides. If riding a tauntaun, he may draw 1 battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

'''Lore:'''
Corman Quien can be called a typical Echo Base scout. He captures, tames, and trains wild tauntauns.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 騎乗する (rides) for creature vehicles, not “drives.” Lore is present tense and specifies wild tauntauns.
